subtitle: Exercise of Geothechnical Engineering
teachers:
TAKAHARA Toshiyuki
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Understand the various problems associated with underground construction of lifeline (electricity, gas, water) facilities in cities and be able to make basic designs.
Students should integrate the knowledge of Soil Mechanics and Geotechnical Engineering, and approach to reasonable design.
advice:
Urban civil engineering
1. Importance and problem of urban civil engineering
2. Design for excavation
3. Design for retaining wall
4. Management of groundwater and settlement
5. Soil compaction
6. Simple evaluation of liquefaction
7. Determination of soil parameters from site test and laboratory test
8. Proposal of integrated approach
books: Reference book: Soilmecahnics, Yasufuku et.al., Riko-tosho
requiredKnowledge: Soil Mechanics I and II, Geotechnical Engineering
